external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Corporate category managers who review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor's platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where the supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A landing bucket in the organisation's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier compliance paperwork is uploaded to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

data_flows.name: review and approve
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in to the supplier document portal using credentials issued by the vendor.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says, "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims do not establish a single encryption-in-transit value.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the extract file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: vendor's platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-hosted platform boundary containing the supplier document portal and the documents that remain on the platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform contains confidential data because it holds compliance documents and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source says the platform holds insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it receives the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source says the bucket receives a supplier data extract, whose contents include supplier information described elsewhere as compliance paperwork and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records derived from the extract.
assumptions.basis: The source says the service writes supplier records into the supplier database, and the extract contains supplier information including staff contact details.
